g.text: The direct role head and the species-to-role mapping disagree on a small but non-zero subset. The one-right / one-wrong subset is the only subset on which expert selection can repair an error. The complete RSG gate

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #20303c

g.text: raises conditional selection above the HRGV reference in the registered comparisons, while the fusion remains below the true-label oracle diagnostic.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #647681

g.text: This is an evidence-structure diagnostic from frozen public-specimen experiments. It does not establish a universal MoE advantage, overall classification superiority, open-set recognition, industrial sorting, grade prediction, or

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #647681
